label: TP
reason: User input from getParameterNames() flows directly into LDAP filter via string concatenation without sanitization. The doSomething() helper passes param unchanged through StringBuilder.toString(), and the filter is used in idc.search() without any effective neutralization. While ESAPI encoder protects attribute values returned from DB, it does not sanitize the filter itself - allowing LDAP injection.

evidence.note: param extracted from request params flows to LDAP filter via string concat
